---
applyTo: '**/*.md'
---

# Documentation Standards

- Write documentation in English
- Use ATX-style headings (`#`, `##`, `###`)
- Include code examples with PHP syntax highlighting (triple backtick php)
- Use relative links for cross-referencing other docs
- Keep line length reasonable (soft wrap at ~120 characters)
- Document classes/interfaces with their namespace and layer (Domain/Infrastructure/Presentation)
- Include usage examples for non-trivial abstractions
